cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We're circling the station. I avoid my old office too. Why this route? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My former boss catches this train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I told mine I'd become a novelist. What did you tell yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That I had a better offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've carried the same blank notebook past mine for a year. Are you avoiding him because there wasn't a better offer?

mechanism: A takes charge of the route and concedes a later train while using A own career pretenses to uncover the motive for B avoiding a former boss.
confusable: Unlike merely sharing similar experience, each disclosure is paired with a narrower motive question; authority adjusts travel to keep B talking.
comparison: Career shame and a false better offer differ from rivalry for a friend affection.
seedUse: D136-b station avoidance, novelist claim and blank notebook; S02-b changes the travel plan around B concern.
